nameForms.name: Kingdom of Denmark
nameForms.note: Early Danish royal line through Canute IV.
nameForms.noteCn: 至克努特四世止的早期丹麦王位主线。

holders.note: Gorm the Old begins this early royal line.
holders.noteCn: 老戈姆开启本早期王位主线。

holders.note: North Sea and Nordic royal transition; not a single-family smooth direct succession.
holders.noteCn: 跨北海与北欧王权转换，不伪装为单一家族平稳直系继承。

holders.note: Norwegian royal transition after Harthacnut; not an Estridsen agnate.
holders.noteCn: 哈德克努特之后的挪威王室过渡统治者，并非埃斯特里森父系。

holders.note: Succeeded through his mother Estrid, daughter of Sweyn Forkbeard; his paternal house remained Ulf's line.
holders.noteCn: 经母亲埃斯特丽德（斯温八字胡之女）取得王位；其父系仍属乌尔夫家系。

holders.note: Succeeded Harald III; Charles the Good is his son, not a Danish king.
holders.noteCn: 继承哈拉尔三世；其子善良的查理并非丹麦国王。

holders.note: Later genealogies traced the Estridsen ancestry to the legendary Sigurd Ring; the link lacks contemporary evidence and is not a parent-child relationship in this database.
holders.noteCn: 后世谱系曾把 Estridsen 的祖源推至传说中的 Sigurd Ring；该联系缺乏同时代证据，不作为本库父子关系。
